topic: Mano and Sheru meet for the first time in the courtyard and become friends.

episode.title: Mano aur Sheru Ki Pehli Dosti

shots.narration: ارے، مانو کی گیند بنچ کے نیچے پھنس گئی!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, colourful Pakistani courtyard beneath a neem tree, low wooden bench with a yellow ball underneath, soft sunlight, rounded 3D family animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano, a white kitten with orange patches, blue eyes and a bell on a red ribbon, stretches one paw toward the unreachable ball.
shots.mood: Bright yellow ball clearly visible beyond a tiny outstretched paw.

shots.narration: تبھی صحن میں شیرو آیا، مانو نے اسے پہلی بار دیکھا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, open courtyard doorway beside the neem tree and wooden bench, colourful Pakistani house, rounded 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Sheru, a brown desi dog with a white chest, pointy ears and a green collar, steps into the courtyard in Mano's view.
shots.mood: Warm sunlight, relaxed ears and a gentle open expression.

shots.narration: [surprised] مانو ذرا شرمائی اور گملے کے پیچھے چھپ گئی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, large terracotta planter near the courtyard bench, Sheru visible at the open doorway, soft 3D family animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano slips behind the planter with her orange-patched ears still visible.
shots.mood: Playfully shy, with a friendly dog standing well back.

shots.narration: شیرو آرام سے بیٹھ گیا، اسے کوئی جلدی نہیں تھی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny Pakistani courtyard, planter in foreground and doorway behind, rounded colourful 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Sheru sits several steps away from Mano's planter.
shots.mood: Patient posture, soft eyes and comfortable space between the friends.

shots.narration: مانو نے جھانک کر بنچ کے نیچے اشارہ کیا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, terracotta planter beside a low wooden bench, yellow ball beneath the bench, Pakistani courtyard, 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano points one paw from behind the planter toward the trapped ball.
shots.mood: Curious blue eyes and an attentive friendly dog.

shots.narration: [whispers] اچھا، تو گیند یہاں چھپی ہوئی ہے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, ground-level view beneath the courtyard bench with the yellow ball in shade, rounded 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Sheru lowers his head to inspect the ball beneath the bench.
shots.mood: Focused friendly face beside a brightly coloured ball.

shots.narration: شیرو نے پنجے سے گیند آہستہ باہر نکال دی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, wooden bench legs on clean courtyard tiles beneath neem shadows, yellow ball near the edge, 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Sheru gently rolls the ball out from under the bench with one paw.
shots.mood: Careful movement, warm light and a clearly freed ball.

shots.narration: مانو خوشی خوشی اپنی گیند کے پاس آ گئی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, open courtyard tiles between the planter and Sheru, freed yellow ball in the centre, colourful 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano trots from the planter to the yellow ball.
shots.mood: Bright blue eyes, lifted tail and Sheru's gentle smile.

shots.narration: [giggles] پھر مانو نے گیند شیرو کی طرف لڑھکا دی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, clear tiled play space under the courtyard neem tree, Mano opposite Sheru, soft 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano nudges the yellow ball toward Sheru with her paw.
shots.mood: Playful invitation, relaxed ears and cheerful faces.

shots.narration: شیرو نے بھی گیند پیار سے واپس کر دی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, sunny Pakistani courtyard with a colourful wall and terracotta pots, Mano facing Sheru, 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Sheru gently rolls the yellow ball back toward Mano.
shots.mood: Friendly eye contact and a shared playful smile.

shots.narration: اب مانو کو شیرو کے پاس بیٹھنا اچھا لگا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, neem shade in the colourful courtyard, Sheru seated beside the yellow ball, rounded 3D animation, no text.
shots.mood: Comfortable closeness, soft smiles and warm dappled sunlight.

shots.narration: [excited] مدد سے دوستی ہوتی ہے؛ اگلی بار چھت پر پتنگ دیکھیں گے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, Mano and Sheru seated together beside their yellow ball in the courtyard, rooftop above with a plain colourful kite safely resting against its inner parapet, 3D animation, no text.
shots.action: Mano and Sheru look up together toward the rooftop kite.
shots.mood: Contented smiles below a bright rooftop discovery.

episode.endHook: اگلی بار چھت پر پتنگ دیکھیں گے!
episode.description: مانو کی گیند صحن کی بنچ کے نیچے پھنس گئی، مگر مدد کے لیے شیرو آ گیا۔ دیکھیے کیسے ایک چھوٹی سی مدد دونوں کی پیاری دوستی بن گئی!
